## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION: Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; Tech and Healthcare leading but overall breadth weak. Confirmations: weak sector breadth (3/11) and Narrow leadership (Top 5 concentrated in Technology), so caution flagged despite strong semiconductor moves.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Technology lead: INTC (1W: +21.33% | 1M: +40.50%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +19.92% | 1M: +34.56%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +10.60% | 1M: +33.21%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials/Healthcare follow: ETN (1W: +11.81% | 1M: +4.67%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +0.10%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -2.35%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -9.30% | 1M: -5.03%) BELOW TREND. Communication/Financials weak: TMUS (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -17.42% | 1M: -22.35%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.26% | 1M: -5.29%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +21.33% | 1M: +40.50%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +19.92% | 1M: +34.56%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +14.25% | 1M: -0.83%) RECOVERY; AMAT (1W: +14.20% | 1M: -2.03%) RECOVERY; ETN (1W: +11.81% | 1M: +4.67%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: EOG (1W: -7.74% | 1M: -7.32%) BELOW TREND; TMUS (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND; WFC (1W: -8.72% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND; RCL (1W: -8.76% | 1M: -20.93%) BELOW TREND; BKNG (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -26.75%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Energy, Comm and Travel-related Consumer Discretionary.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +21.33%), AMD (1W: +19.92%), LRCX (1W: +14.25%), AMAT (1W: +14.20%), META (1W: +10.60%) — many semiconductors showing strong 1W gains. Note minor divergence pattern across several semis (LRCX, AMAT, ASML, SHOP) in RECOVERY (1W up | 1M down) — tactical momentum, watch for follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech mixed but leading on concentrated semis strength: AAPL (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +2.73%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.43% | 1M: +8.29%) ABOVE TREND; but multiple names in RECOVERY (LRCX, AMAT, ASML, SHOP). Sector breadth: Technology positive but narrow (1W: +4.25%, 24 stocks) — momentum concentrated.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials showing weakness: JPM (1W: -3.26% | 1M: -5.29%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -3.75% | 1M: -2.57%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -2.33% | 1M: -3.57%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -8.72% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Financials negative (1W: -3.62%, 20 stocks) — adds to overall caution.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare holding up modestly: JNJ (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +0.10%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +0.39%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.31% | 1M: -8.32%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth: Healthcare mildly positive (1W: +1.01%, 17 stocks) and acting as a defensive offset.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective exposure to semiconductor/AI beneficiaries (INTC, AMD, NVDA, META) while reducing exposure to structurally weak Energy and Communication names (XOM, CHTR, TMUS) given narrow leadership and weak breadth. Style: Growth/momentum concentrated in semiconductors but overall market mixed — stay selective and monitor follow-through.

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +21.33% | 1M: +40.50%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +19.92% | 1M: +34.56%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +10.60% | 1M: +33.21%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -17.42% | 1M: -22.35%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -8.72% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology (semiconductor-led, 1W: +4.25%) and Industrials (1W: +0.95%) for potential continuation. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -5.62%), Communication (1W: -4.16%) and Financials (1W: -3.62%) given persistent weakness.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch INTC: sustainment above recent breakout zone for continuation (ABOVE TREND). Monitor NVDA near near-term resistance for confirmation of broader tech follow-through (ABOVE TREND). Track CHTR and TMUS for failure levels that would widen sector weakness (both BELOW TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
SHOP (+55): Meta integrated agent-commerce headline; price RECOVERY (1W: +9.53% | 1M: -4.98%) — sentiment confirms short-term momentum but 1M down implies tactical, not broad accumulation. (Only SHOP from the bullish list shows clear 1W/1M data in the set.)

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
INTC (-60): headline on dividend/divestiture pressure but price ABOVE TREND (1W: +21.33% | 1M: +40.50%) — clear divergence (distribution risk). CHTR (-50): headline on customer exodus and price BELOW TREND (1W: -17.42% | 1M: -22.35%) — sentiment confirmed. BA (-45): geopolitical deal concern and price BELOW TREND (1W: -1.01% | 1M: -5.00%) — sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with Growth/momentum concentrated in semiconductors; Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive and leadership is Narrow (4/5 Technology). INTC (1W: +21.33% | 1M: +40.50%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +19.92% | 1M: +34.56%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +10.60% | 1M: +33.21%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: bearish headlines on INTC (-60) while the stock is ABOVE TREND indicates distribution risk and narrow leadership—monitor SHOP RECOVERY and CHTR BELOW TREND for confirmation.
